title: Hazardous component
description: A hazardous component of a waste item: its name, and either its concentration as an amount with a unit or how its concentration compares with the relevant threshold, but not both.

name.description: The hazardous component's name, as free text. Not checked against any reference data.

unit.description: The unit of the amount: milligrams per kilogram. Required when 'amount' is provided.

amount.description: The component's concentration, in 'unit': a number greater than 0. Exactly one of 'amount' or 'threshold' is required.

threshold.description: How the component's concentration compares with the relevant threshold, when the amount itself isn't given: equal to it or greater than it. The threshold value isn't sent. Exactly one of 'amount' or 'threshold' is required.
